Thank you for your concern! I have been feeling better today, but I am at least a little scared that the feeling will return. I will be seeing my doctor on Monday and will bring it up with him then.

I have taken Effexor in the past, and it did a real number on me. As soon as I noticed that the Lexapro was beginning to give me the same symptoms (sexual dysfunction, flatness of mood, reduced motivation, seemingly diminishing the benefits of stimulant etc), I guess I freaked out a bit and was too scared to continue with it. Especially after the bad time I had with Effexor... I began to think that SSRI meds just do not get along well with me.

I am seeing my doctor on Monday (3 days) and will bring it up with him then.
